reviewInstructions.scope: Evaluate each bounded candidate exactly as written. Do not grant credit for extensions that are not in the minimum study.
reviewInstructions.evidenceRule: Reopen primary papers and official repositories when a score depends on a factual claim. Treat unchecked author promises as unavailable.
reviewInstructions.independenceRule: Do not seek or use another reviewer's scores.

sharedAssetFacts: The audited tree contains exactly 46 InterDrive, 112 Interaction, and 67 V2XPnP scenario leaves; all 278 JSON and 6603 active XML files parsed.

MDrive exposes four perception_swap detector variants under a common planner interface, pose-error and latency variants, per-tick prediction dumps, AP/ADE/FDE/predicted-collision metrics, and closed-loop driving scores.
MDrive requires CARLA 0.9.12, external checkpoints, and planner-specific environments; HEAL-backed variants are budgeted at roughly 16 GB GPU memory.
MDrive's current --openloop help text and runtime behavior disagree: the runtime keeps normal closed-loop control unless CUSTOM_EGO_LOG_REPLAY=1 is explicitly set.
MDrive documents unequal native AP visibility filters across CoDriving and perception_swap; comparisons must either stay inside one interface family or use --no-visibility-filter.
RCP-Bench commit bf999089d1a56265cdfc1238ef4d065fb74602fa was statically audited; it is academic-only and uses a legacy CUDA stack.
No CUDA inference or CARLA rollout was claimed during this audit.

candidates.title: 单决策点安全随机消息试验与可证伪离策略评估
candidates.hook: 不从相关日志猜哪条 V2X 消息有用，而是在每条路线只随机一次、记录真实倾向概率，并用独立随机 rollout 检验离线估计到底可信不可信。
candidates.boundedResearchQuestion: 在预先声明的 MDrive 场景、一个消息区域和固定三秒结果窗内，安全筛选后的 admit/drop 随机试验能否识别该消息对规划风险的条件效应，并判断直接模型、IPW 与 doubly robust 估计何时可以替代额外在线 rollout？
noveltyBoundary: Select2Drive、Defer to Plan 与 receiver-centric communication 已研究哪些信息值得融合，但没有公开记录随机消息处理、行为倾向概率和独立随机策略验证的闭环协议。
UECP 与 RCP-Bench 能描述不确定性或负协作，却不能从自适应融合日志识别同一消息未发送时的规划结果。
Self-Supervised Relevance Modelling 通过合成反事实数据学习目标相关性；本候选改为真实随机处理日志、固定结果窗和可审计 OPE 误差。
本候选不声称解决多步自适应通信，也不声称给真实道路安全保证。贡献边界是单决策、受筛选场景中的可识别消息效应与 OPE 有效性协议。
candidates.preciseClaim: For one preregistered communication decision per episode and a deterministic pre-treatment safety screen, exact logged propensities plus cross-fitted doubly robust estimation can produce confidence intervals whose empirical coverage and policy-value error are validated against held-out randomized MDrive rollouts. The study publishes failure regions when overlap or effective sample size is inadequate.
identificationDesign: Treatment unit is one region-time message at the first preregistered occlusion trigger; no later message decision is evaluated, removing sequential-treatment and post-treatment-policy ambiguity.
The deterministic screen excludes states where dropping the message violates a conservative TTC or braking-envelope rule. The estimand is explicitly conditional on states that pass this screen.

Within the retained population, admit/drop is Bernoulli with a fixed probability logged before delivery. Propensity, payload hash, serialized bytes, send/receive timestamps, planner state, map, route, actors, network trace, and perturbation seed are immutable log fields.

The result window is fixed at three seconds. Primary outcomes are collision indicator and minimum TTC; route progress, comfort, violations, actual bytes, and end-to-end latency are secondary outcomes.

Nuisance models are cross-fitted by complete scenario family. Direct, IPW, self-normalized IPW, and doubly robust estimates are compared with fresh randomized-policy rollouts not used to fit any model.

The candidate succeeds scientifically whether OPE is valid only in a narrow overlap region or fails broadly, because both outcomes establish an executable decision rule for when logged cooperative-driving evidence is insufficient.

minimumStudy.duration: 10-12 weeks after a one-scenario MDrive smoke test passes
minimumStudy.compute: One CUDA GPU with at least 24 GB memory; CARLA scenario-pool use is optional and not required for the pilot.
systems: MDrive perception_swap_attfuse_behavior as the primary cooperative stack
MDrive perception_swap_fcooper_behavior as a held-out fusion-family replication
MDrive V2XPnP and Interaction scenario families
samplePlan: Pilot 20 scenario families spanning occlusion, crossing, merge, and braking mechanisms.
Four independent initial seeds per family, two treatment arms, two cooperative stacks, and three declared network/pose strata.
Increase seeds only if the preregistered confidence-width and effective-sample-size calculation requires it; do not select sample size after seeing the treatment effect.
metrics: Coverage and absolute error of policy-value confidence intervals against held-out randomized rollouts
Effective sample size, propensity overlap, weight-tail diagnostics, and disagreement among estimators
Collision, minimum TTC, progress, comfort, violations, serialized bytes, and end-to-end latency
Transfer error on the second fusion family and held-out perturbation stratum

negativeControls: Sham randomization changes a log flag but not delivery.
Pre-message placebo outcome is measured before treatment.
Messages from empty or planner-irrelevant regions are randomized.
Within-scene payload permutation preserves byte count and delivery timing.
Equal-compute ego-only inference controls for latency and scheduling effects.
A deliberately reconstructed rather than logged propensity tests whether hidden policy inference creates false confidence.
successCriteria: Every reported estimand names its screened population, treatment, horizon, and available pre-treatment variables.
At least one estimator has preregistered interval coverage and value error that agree with held-out randomized evaluation in the supported strata.
Unsupported strata are rejected by overlap or effective-sample-size diagnostics rather than assigned a policy value.
The second fusion family preserves the qualitative validity verdict, even if the estimated treatment effect differs.
Actual serialization and latency accounting do not reverse the reported validity conclusion.
killCriteria: A one-scenario smoke test cannot log exact pre-treatment propensities, payload hashes, and synchronized outcomes.
Safety screening leaves no informative treatment variation in occlusion or conflict states.
Held-out randomized outcomes fall outside claimed intervals after the preregistered sample expansion.
Estimator validity depends on post-treatment variables, future frames, oracle actor state, or reconstruction of unlogged propensities.
The protocol cannot reproduce its own result from the released immutable log.
implementationMilestones: Week 1-2: environment lockfile, checkpoint hashes, one-scenario smoke test, and message interception point.
Week 3: preregistered trigger, screen, schema, estimand, sample rule, and negative controls.
Week 4-6: randomized logging over the pilot set and deterministic integrity checks.
Week 7-8: cross-fitted estimators, overlap diagnostics, and held-out randomized validation.
Week 9-10: second fusion-family replication and perturbation holdout.
Week 11-12: rerun from clean logs, package artifacts, and write positive or negative result.

candidates.title: 可执行实验契约下的回放—闭环 verdict 迁移审计
candidates.hook: 不再把不同代码、过滤器和指标下的榜单数字硬做相关性，而是在同一场景、同一接口、同一检查点上测量一个方法从回放到闭环时是否真正翻转结论。
candidates.boundedResearchQuestion: 在 MDrive 的 perception_swap 统一接口与同一 V2XPnP 场景中，固定实现和 evaluator 后，协同感知方法在纯回放预测指标上的相对 verdict 能否迁移到闭环 ego 控制；若不能，哪些可观测变量解释 sign/rank inversion？
noveltyBoundary: MDrive 已指出 perception sharing 不总能转化为 planning gain，也提供每 tick 预测和闭环输出；它没有给出冻结实现、配对场景、反转概率和可执行可比性契约。
RCP-Bench 比较受控腐败下的感知鲁棒性，但不研究同一实现从回放到闭环的 verdict 迁移。
CooperScene 和 V2X-ReaLO 提供更真实通信或在线证据，却不能替代同场景、同检查点的闭环干预。
本候选只对 audited MDrive modes 与指定方法族作结论，不把 V2XPnP 回放称为真实道路闭环，也不声称所有 benchmark 都存在排序反转。
candidates.preciseClaim: An executable comparison contract that freezes code, checkpoints, visibility filtering, sensor inputs, message serialization, scenario identity, and metric definitions can support paired estimation of replay-to-closed-loop sign and rank inversion for four cooperative perception swaps. The contract must distinguish true ego replay from closed-loop control despite the current CLI documentation/runtime mismatch.
comparisonContract: Store repository commit, container or environment lock, CARLA build hash, checkpoint hashes, planner alias, fusion alias, sensor suite, map, route XML hashes, actor manifest hashes, random seeds, and GPU type.
Use only perception_swap_{fcooper,attfuse,disco,cobevt}_behavior in the primary matrix so the local planner and AP collection path are shared.
Force one declared visibility policy for every method. Native-filter and no-filter results are separate strata, never pooled.
Log serialized payload bytes and measured end-to-end latency rather than feature-mask size.
Define playback explicitly with CUSTOM_EGO_LOG_REPLAY=1 and closed-loop explicitly without it; assert the effective environment in every run artifact.
Freeze all choices before opening closed-loop outcomes. A contract checker rejects cells with mismatched hashes or evaluator settings.

minimumStudy.duration: 10-12 weeks after all four methods pass one-scene smoke tests
minimumStudy.compute: One or more CUDA GPUs with at least 24 GB; the primary matrix may be serialized if no scenario pool is available.
levels: L0 true ego replay: controls discarded with CUSTOM_EGO_LOG_REPLAY=1; report AP, ADE, FDE, and predicted collision rate.

L1 closed-loop ego on the same V2XPnP route and recorded actors with the documented intelligent guard; report the same per-tick metrics plus driving score, success, infractions, and realized collision.
L2 reactive replication on matched MDrive Interaction mechanisms; used only for external-validity direction, not treated as a paired real-log level.
samplePlan: Select 20 V2XPnP scenes before outcome inspection, stratified by occlusion, crossing, merge, braking, and infrastructure availability.
Run four independent seeds per method and level; use paired bootstrap by scene family and seed.
Replicate the most stable and most unstable method pair on 20 matched Interaction scenarios.
Expand only under a preregistered confidence-width rule.
metrics: Probability of pairwise sign inversion for cooperative gain versus an ego-only ablation built through the same perception_swap path
Posterior or bootstrap probability of rank inversion across methods
Failure-set Jaccard overlap and per-scene verdict agreement
AP, ADE, FDE, predicted collision, realized collision, minimum TTC, progress, success, infractions, bytes, and latency
Sensitivity to visibility policy, actor guard, pose error, latency, and checkpoint variation

negativeControls: Duplicate one checkpoint under a second method label; the contract should report no genuine method effect.
Shuffle scene pairings before transfer analysis; apparent transportability should degrade.
Intentionally mix native visibility filters; the checker must reject the comparison.
Change only the documented mode label while preserving the effective environment; the checker must detect no level change.
Allow per-level retuning as a deliberately biased comparator but exclude it from the primary verdict.
Replace actual bytes with feature-mask size to quantify the invalid shortcut.
successCriteria: Every primary comparison cell passes the executable contract and can be regenerated from a manifest.
The study reports uncertainty over every sign/rank inversion, not a correlation of copied headline metrics.
At least one independent rerun reproduces a selected transfer cell from hashes and manifests.
A negative result with narrow intervals is accepted: stable rankings within the bounded scope are as informative as a confirmed inversion.
Sensitivity analysis separates evaluator/filter changes from genuine replay-to-closed-loop interactions.
killCriteria: Fewer than four methods pass the shared-interface smoke test.
The ego-only ablation cannot be implemented through the same ground-truth and planner path.
Mode, checkpoint, visibility filter, message serialization, or metric definitions cannot be frozen and fingerprinted.
V2XPnP cells cannot be paired at scene/seed level or the resulting intervals remain uninformative after preregistered expansion.
Observed inversions disappear once evaluator mismatches are removed, in which case the result is published only as an evaluator-confound audit and not as evidence-level transfer.
implementationMilestones: Week 1-2: four one-scene smoke tests, ego-only ablation, and contract schema.
Week 3: mode assertions, visibility-policy assertions, checkpoint and scenario fingerprints.
Week 7: inversion statistics, duplicate-checkpoint and shuffled-pair controls.
Week 8-9: pose, latency, guard, and filter sensitivity.
Week 10: Interaction replication on two selected method pairs.
Week 11-12: clean rerun, independent cell replication, and artifact release.
